Follow up on buyer approvals, comments, samples and development requirements.  Maintain strong and professional customer relationships.  Participate in buyer calls and meetings and provide clear updates on order status.  Escalate commercial, quality or delivery risks proactively.    Product Development & Costing ​ Review new styles, tech packs, specifications and BOMs.  Coordinate development of fabrics, trims, accessories and packaging.  Work closely with the sourcing team to obtain competitive fabric and trim prices.  Prepare accurate garment costing and negotiate where required.  Review consumption, fabric width, GSM, wastage, trims, CM and logistics costs.  Identify opportunities to reduce product cost without compromising quality.  Coordinate sample development and ensure samples are submitted on time and the right quality standard.  Ensure all development comments are properly recorded and followed through from sampling to bulk production.    Order Management ​ Manage orders from PO receipt to shipment through the ERP System.  Review POs carefully for quantity, price, delivery date, fabric, trims and special requirements.  Prepare and maintain order trackers.  Monitor critical path activities and ensure all milestones are achieved.  Coordinate with planning, production, sourcing, quality and logistics teams.  Monitor fabric and trim availability against production requirements.  Identify potential delays early and develop recovery plans.    Production Follow-Up ​ Monitor production progress against the agreed production plan.  Work closely with production and planning teams to ensure shipment commitments are achieved.  Follow up on cutting, sewing, finishing, packing and final inspection timelines and numbers and ensure all data points are correct in reports and ERP.  Ensure production issues are communicated to the relevant stakeholders immediately.  Support resolution of production and quality issues affecting delivery.  Coordinate with QA/QC teams to ensure customer requirements are met.  ​ Raw Material & Sourcing Coordination ​ Work closely with the sourcing team to ensure timely availability of fabrics and trims.  Monitor fabric booking, lab dips, strike-offs, testing, approvals and bulk deliveries against the Critical Path (CP) and raise any red flags in the CP meeting.  Track fabric and trim shortages and excess inventory.  Ensure materials are aligned with the correct PO/style and delivery requirement.  Support sourcing negotiations and alternative supplier development where required.  Maintain close coordination with mills and suppliers.  ​ Quality & Compliance ​ Ensure customer quality standards and specifications are understood and communicated. Ensure all approvals are received before bulk production.  Support corrective actions for quality issues. Ensure commercial/shipping documents are prepared correctly and on time.  Coordinate with freight forwarders and internal logistics teams.  Identify vessel rollovers, port delays or other logistics risks and communicate recovery plans.  Ensure shipment status is accurately updated until the goods reach the required destination.
